item.title: 6 Ways Predestination Is an Outworking of God’s Love
item.description: Predestination is that act in eternity past in which God ordained or decreed that those he had set his steadfast love on would inherit eternal life.

item.title: What Is the Purpose of the Book of Romans?
item.description: We want to know why Paul wrote this letter, but there’s also a practical purpose. namely, what use are we going to put the book of Romans to?

item.title: 10 Key Bible Verses on Hell
item.description: ”But if the LORD creates something new, and the ground opens its mouth and swallows them up with all that belongs to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall know that these men have despised the LORD.”

item.title: 7 Practices for Spiritual Progress According to George Whitefield
item.description: Whitefield examined seven practices to encourage spiritual progress. He argued that spiritual disciplines “are means; but then they are only means; they are part, but not the whole of religion.”

item.title: Why Does Jesus Silence People Who Say Who He Is? (Mark 1)
item.description: Generally speaking, Jesus had to defer the full disclosure of his identity because God’s Messiah was to die and be raised from death in order to be enthroned as the eternal Messiah-ruler.

item.title: A Poem for Those Whose Faith Feels Stale
item.description: Far too often, old truths turn stale. All the wonder leaks out. So we need fresh ways of seeing and saying that re-colorize the picture and reawaken awe. Poetry does that.

item.title: Podcast: Get to Know Your Favorite Theologians’ Favorite Poet (Stephen Witmer)
item.description: Dr. Stephen Witmer discusses how reading George Herbert’s poetry is a way to shepherd our souls, live counter-culturally, and see Christ differently.

item.title: How to Share Your Faith Even If You’re Uncomfortable with Making People Uncomfortable
item.description: For people who tend to be more timid or uncomfortable with the thought of making other people uncomfortable, how do you share the gospel? Here are a couple things I would strongly recommend.
